header: Draws a hospital OPD answer: the title with its Open / Closed badge, the one-line verdict, THE TABLE FIRST, the short points, the pointer (for example the Emergency Department) and the red notes (the OPD and card registration hours by the clock). Plain text only (React escapes it); I never let the badge or the verdict rest on colour alone: their words carry the meaning.

symbols.name: TONE
symbols.sig: const TONE: Record<"open" | "closed" | "unknown" | "info", string> = { open: "bg-green-100 text-green-900 border-green-200", closed: "bg-red-100 text-red-900 border-red-200", unknown: …

symbols.name: HEADLINE
symbols.sig: const HEADLINE: Record<"yes" | "no" | "info" | "unknown", string> = { yes: "text-green-600", no: "text-red-600", info: "text-neutral-900", unknown: "text-amber-600", }
doc: The headline is the answer itself, large and bold. I chose text-2xl, one step below the first version (text-3xl), which looked heavy for a long value such as "DNB(MEDICINE)" (26 Oct 2026). Green Yes, red No, amber when it is not known; a plain value is dark. The words carry the meaning, never the colour alone.

doc: Under a Yes or No headline I do not repeat the word in the sentence.

doc: I never break a short cell ("OPD 12", "Unit III", "not recorded", a ticket) over two lines; a long one (the days, a name with a note) wraps as it needs to. I give the first column (Unit / OPD / Room) a little more room.

behaviours: the title is shown
the badge is a word, beside the title, in a green pill for Open
the verdict is shown with its words and its tone
the table has the three column headers and one row per row (an empty cell is empty)
the header cells are real column headers for a screen reader
THE TABLE COMES FIRST: before the points, the pointer and the notes
the order is title, badge, verdict, table, points, pointer, notes
the points are bullets
the pointer is one bullet per line inside its blue box
the notes are red bullets
the table can scroll sideways on a narrow screen
each extra table has its caption and its own headers
an extra table with no rows is not drawn
the captions come in order, after the verdict and before the points
the rows are drawn (an empty cell stays empty)
captions and cells of extra tables are escaped
the banner is drawn, with its own mark, and says when he is available
the banner comes right after the verdict and before the table
the banner is green and bold (eye-catching), not the grey of an ordinary point
the question is the LAST thing, after the red hours
a card with neither has neither
the banner and the question are escaped
'OPD 12' stays on one line (first column, short)
'not recorded' and a ticket stay on one line
a long cell still wraps: the days, a name with a note, a long ticket text, a first cell longer than 24 characters
the headers never wrap
a one-line pointer is a sentence, not a list with one bullet
nothing else is drawn when only a title is given
a table with no rows, no points and no notes are not drawn
text is escaped, never run (title, badge, points, pointer, notes, table)
badge ${tone} has its own colour and its word
verdict ${tone} has its own colour classes
with a handler, each department's name is a button carrying its question
only the FIRST column is pressable (the OPD numbers are not)
without a handler (or without asks) nothing is a button: the same plain table as before
